# Art director spec (2026-10-01): one master composition for every Steam asset

*Synthesized from the four research reports, then attacked by three critics (Steam mechanics, pixel craft, marketing) and revised. Generated by a research workflow; numbers are the spec's own and were not all verified in Steamworks.*

## Principles

- ONE WORLD, ONE MOMENT. Every store and library image is a window on one scene: the Malibu Club at 19:19 (sky_cycle key t=0.16, 'the sun on the towers'). The camera is the player's place behind the bar, the same direction the game looks (GDD 18 section 1: the player looks out from behind the bar, with the guest in front and the club behind them). Roxy is on the GUEST side of the counter, facing us. Below the counter's near edge we see our own side, the underbar. The guest-side foot rail and speed lines are never drawn: they would put Roxy behind the bar and tell viewers they play her. Three things change between assets: the window, Roxy's pose (B stand / A lean, with the camera height following the pose) and the periphery. The clock never changes, event art included.

- ONE PIXEL GRID, HONESTLY SCALED. In every Steam image, 1 art px = 4x4 upload px; the icons are the one exception, at x8 (L10). Compose at native size, enlarge with NEAREST, then cut overflow from the RIGHT and BOTTOM only. Never centre-crop, resample, rotate, skew or blur. Steam shows exactly 2 screen px per art px only at 231x87, 616x353, 374x448, 300x450 and the hero's 1920x620. Elsewhere it shows 1.0-1.6 screen px: the store header at about 375x175 [3rd-party, Immutable], and the 292x136, 184x69 and 120x45 copies. Steam also re-encodes to JPG [from memory]. So nothing that has to read may be a single art px: the card is 24x15, the coupe bowl is 12 wide and the eyes stay 4 px wide. Rims and glints are a bonus. The logo is the one screen-resolution layer, as it is in the game, where the title sign is drawn per HUD factor so that one texel is one screen px. It is composited after the x4, at x,y multiples of 4.

- ONE CLOSED PALETTE OF 84 INKS: the 40 UITheme inks plus Roxy's 44 identity inks. The UITheme inks are the Night, Magenta, Cyan, ClubBlue, Amber, ViceRed, Cream and Graphite ramps. The identity inks are every ink of Assets/Resources/Patron/hostess/idle/idle_00.png, with its four near-blacks merged into #11080C; her hoops' #FCED5F doubles as the sun core. Identity inks appear only inside Roxy. Every effect is an explicit lookup table (base ink + band -> ink), never alpha-then-snap: the critique measured alpha-then-snap turning the sky grey and skin-coloured. No effect may output Graphite, Cream[0]-[2] or an identity ink. The logo's own glow blends are the only off-palette pixels.

- A RIGID HERO GROUP, anchored on F, Roxy's eye-line midpoint. These all move with her as one block:
  - sun centre F+(-30,+24), radius 12
  - halo radii 15/21/27/33
  - horizon F+42
  - counter far edge F+79 (pose B) or F+52 (pose A)
  - coupe F+(-36..-25, +12..+28), its bowl over the disc's upper half
  - ID card F+(+17..+40, -4..+10), held up beside her room-side cheek
  - tower cluster from sun.x-56 to sun.x+50
  - glitter path
  The light, the rims and the sky behind her head are the same in every asset. At least 45% of the disc stays visible, with its upper-left arc unbroken. Only the periphery is re-snapped to each frame: bottles, guests, palms, the wall wing, the low skyline, birds and stars.

- HEAD IN THE NIGHT, SHOULDERS IN THE FIRE (measured, WCAG). The band rows are tied to F. S0-S1 lie above F+4, S2 runs F+4..F+16, S3 F+16..F+20, and the warm stack runs F+20..F+42.
  - Her crown (F-20) sits on Night[1]. Hair there is only 1.06-1.9:1, so a 1-px Magenta[2] crown rim (3.3-3.6:1) defines it.
  - Face and jaw sit on Night[2]/ClubBlue[1] (KEY skin 5-6:1).
  - Shoulders (F+21) sit on Magenta[1]. Skin is 2.2-4.0:1 there, and the 1-px Cyan[4] room-side rim (5.9:1) carries the edge.
  - The hair's sun side meets the halo and the disc: dark hair on gold is 16:1.
  - The suit sits on Magenta[3]/ViceRed[4] (3.1-4.1:1).
  The sun stays behind her sun-side shoulder and coupe: never behind her face, and never on the logo's side of the frame.

- THE LOGO LIVES ON THE NIGHT. Each logo has a PAD = its glow bounding box + 16 upload px on every side. Inside the pad there is no sun disc, no halo lift of any ring, no sprite, palm, guest, star, lit window, ripple or glint, and no diagonal band edge. The sun centre stays at least 33 native px from every pad, so even the faintest ring stays out.
  On the logo side the band edges are horizontal:
  - The script sits only on S0-S2 (L* <= 21) and crosses at most one Night-to-Night edge.
  - The cyan subtitle and its glow sit on ONE ink from S0-S2. Never Night[4] (L* 25.3) and never Magenta: Cyan glow turns grey on warm bands.
  - One more band edge may run in the 2-px gap between the script's glow and the subtitle's glow (x1 map rows 147-150).
  Each asset's logo position is solved against this rule, and its bed is listed per asset.

- LAYOUT GRAMMAR FROM THE GENRE.
  1) Landscape assets: logo upper-left, Roxy's face on the right third, bar props along the bottom-left (Hotline Miami's one hot field, one figure and a script logo; VA-11 Hall-A's bartender-as-face). The text-left / character-right trend is attributed to Zukowski, unverified.
  2) Portrait assets are recomposed as a stack: logo / face cluster / counter (Stardew, Cult of the Lamb).
  3) The small capsule is logo-only and nearly full-bleed (Steamworks).
  4) The hero has no text and keeps a calm field for the overlaid logo that holds under every client crop.
  5) The sun behind the figure works as Sea of Stars' moon does: a halo that is also the sunset.

- ONE CLUSTER, TWO VERBS. Roxy always looks into the camera. Her torso turns at least 45 degrees toward the sun and the logo; her head is the game's own frontal head.
  - Sun-side hand: raises the pink coupe so the bowl is silhouetted on the gold disc. This is the pour, and the emblem the icon repeats.
  - Room-side hand: holds a GUEST's ID card up beside her cheek, the way a doorman holds a card next to a face. This is the read, the game's hook and its hidden information, and it is the lesson her own tour teaches. The photo is a guest (Amber[3] hair), not her.
  Coupe, face and card make one row at face height. The eye path has two stops: logo -> the face cluster (with the disc behind it). Everything else is atmosphere.

- GENRE ON THE COUNTER, MIAMI IN THE SKY.
  - Every Roxy frame carries the navy-marble counter, the coupe and the card, plus 2-6 backlit bottles (and the shaker where there is room) standing on OUR counter top on the logo side, below the pad.
  - Seated, unread guest silhouettes appear in the main capsule, the hero and the event header.
  - Miami comes from the sunset bands, the bay, the game's own palms, its own skyline (traced from curtain_city.png), Deco grammar (pilaster, ziggurat shelf top, bullnose) and exactly two neon hues, Magenta and Cyan.
  - BANNED: perspective laser grid, chrome, cars, VHS/CRT/scanlines/chromatic aberration, a striped synthwave sun, a second sun (the counter-door mural is not used), green/yellow/orange neon, more than two neon hues, any dither, any readable word except the logo, any letter-like glyph on the card, shelf or signs.

- THREE VALUE MASSES, NOT THREE PIXELS. A skin tone cannot outshine a sunset (KEY skin L* 74 vs Cream[4] 92), so the gate is masses: (1) the logo, (2) the sun disc with the coupe on it, (3) the face with the card beside it.
  Brightness is budgeted to make that true:
  - The card body is Cream[3], with Cream[4] only on its top edge.
  - The counter's neon core is Cream[4] only within F.x +/- 40.
  - At most 2 #FCED5F glitter dashes.
  - No full-width Cream line anywhere.
  - Roxy's Cream[4] budget: one catchlight per eye, one hoop pixel, one sugar-rim pixel, plus the card's top edge.
  In greyscale there are three masses: the dark night and logo field, the bright horizon and sun, and the figure.

- THE GAME'S LIGHT LANGUAGE.
  - SUN, behind and to the left: a 1-px Amber[4] rim on edges that face the sun within 42 px of its centre. The rim is dropped where the background is the disc or S8/S9 (1.3:1 there would erode the silhouette); the darkest material step is the edge instead.
  - NEON, from the room side: a 1-px Cyan[4] rim on EVERY screen-right silhouette edge of Roxy and the props, whatever the distance. It is motivated by the cyan moon sign.
  - SKY: a 1-px Magenta[2] rim on the top of her hair; a ClubBlue[2] skylight rim on palm fronds over S0-S3.
  - KEY, from above and in front: face, hands, card.
  - FILL: ClubBlue/Night shadows.
  Never pure black, never grey, never two rims on one pixel.

- CRAFT RULES (Saint11, Derek Yu, Slynyrd, Lospec).
  - 1-px selective outlines in the darkest step of each material, Night[0] where a shape meets the sky.
  - Binary alpha. Hard stepped band edges whose boundaries change by at most 1 row per step, with runs of at least 2 px.
  - NO DITHER ANYWHERE. It moires at Steam's non-integer scales and turns to mosquito noise in JPG, and the author removed the in-game sky's ordered dither on 2026-09-22 (WindowSky.cs 339-346: 'pixel pixel gun batimi').
  - Clusters, not noise:
    - stars at most 1 per 2000 px^2, plus a few 3x3 plus-stars
    - windows as 2x1 runs, at most 1 per 40 px^2
    - birds as 5x2 Ms (.X.X. over X...X)
    - no orphan pixels, line steps of 1-2-3

- VICE CITY AS MOOD, STEAM RULES AS LAW.
  - 'Malibu Club' is a GTA: Vice City property and Malibu is a rum brand. So: no comic-panel grid box art, no Pricedown-style lettering, no Tommy-style hero, no white bottle with a palm or sunset label, no real hotel names or sign shapes. The bar props are what keep this from reading as fan art.
  - Base capsules may carry only art, the game name and the official subtitle. 'COCKTAIL BAR SIMULATOR' is legal only if the Steamworks store name is exactly 'Malibu Club: Cocktail Bar Simulator': verify it.
  - Capsules are shown in all-ages contexts. Roxy's halter V closes at F+36 (shallower than the sprite), with skin inside it only from F+18 to F+30. The pose is warm, never coy. Steam's PG-13 limit is met; the hostess-club misread is what we avoid.

- PIPELINE, WITH STEP 0 FIRST.
  STEP 0, blocking:
  (a) Build the new logo sets x0.75, x0.9 and x2.2857. Add them to build_logo.py SETS; they need Tools/title_sign/work/masters.npz, which is git-ignored and absent on this machine, plus the author's OK, because the logo is fixed and only its render size changes. Write them to Tools/title_sign/out/maps, never to Assets.
  (b) Give logo_render.render() a map-path argument.
  (c) Fix Tools/steam_page/pixelsnap.py. It accepts a float period and searches only the phase (np.arange(0, period, 0.25)); it adds a --palette flag; it adds the ViceRed ramp and the identity inks to its 84-ink palette; it snaps in OKLab; it keys #00FF00 with despill before sampling. Today a forced period crashes.
  Then:
  - CODE draws the sky, sun, halo, bay, glitter, skyline placement, counter and effects, and composites the logo.
  - Roxy's HEAD is idle_00 copied 1:1. Her body is hand-drawn, or made by PixelLab at native size; Gemini is used only as a pose reference.
  - Palms are the game's own sprites. The skyline is hand-traced from curtain_city.png.
  - Wall wing and guests come from PixelLab at native size, or from Gemini through the fixed snapper.
  - Props and icons are hand-pixelled.
  - PNG everywhere; the community icon is JPG.

- QA GATES ON EVERY ASSET.
  (1) At most 84 distinct inks outside the logo box.
  (2) A NEAREST round trip (x4 down to native and back) is byte-identical outside the logo box. Run it on the UNCUT x4 canvas, because 430/4 = 107.5.
  (3) The pad is clean and the sun is at least 33 native px from it.
  (4) The bed matches the asset's table.
  (5) Display test: Lanczos downscale, then JPEG q80 4:2:0 and q85 4:4:4, at 375x175, 460x215, 292x136, 184x69, 120x45, 231x87, 616x353, 575x269 (1.25 DPR), 374x448, 300x450, 150x225, a 110-px-wide grid tile, and the hero at 1920x620 and 1600x517. The script must be legible at 120x45; the subtitle may fail there but must pass at 184x69. The face and card must be identifiable at 292x136 and 300x450.
  (6) At 120 px wide the three brightest masses are the logo, the sun+coupe and the face+card.
  (7) Shares: Night/ClubBlue 55-65%, warm 25-30%, Cyan <= 10%, no single ink > 50%, pixels with S > 0.4 <= 40%.
  (8) At least 45% of the disc is visible.
  (9) Roxy's head pixels equal idle_00 rows 4-43, except the listed hand edits.


## Master

**Concept.** MALIBU CLUB, 19:19, the doors just opened. We stand at our own station behind the bar, as the player does in the game, looking out through the club's open west front at Biscayne Bay.

The counter: a Tier-3 navy-marble counter runs across the bottom of the frame. Its top is seen from our side, and under its near edge a magenta neon strip glows down onto our underbar. Our tools stand on the counter on the logo side: a few backlit bottles and a shaker, silhouetted against the sunset in the lean frames and against the dark bay in the standing frames.

Roxy: across the counter, on the guests' side, ROXY VALE, the hostess, the face of the game, stands at the bar (pose B) or leans on it on her elbows (pose A). Her head is the game's own sprite, frontal and smiling into the camera; her torso is turned toward the sun.
- Her sun-side hand raises a pink coupe so that its bowl is silhouetted on the low gold sun.
- Her room-side hand holds a guest's ID card up beside her cheek, the read the game is about.
Coupe, face and card make one row.

The sky: the sun sits on the towers of a small downtown skyline (traced from the game's curtain_city) just behind her sun-side shoulder. A stepped halo lifts the sky around it, and a broken glitter path crosses the bay toward us.
- Above her head the sky is night: Night[1] -> Night[2] -> ClubBlue[1] -> Night[4].
- Behind her shoulders burns the warm stack: Magenta -> ViceRed -> Amber. It is hottest and deepest at the sun and recedes to a pink line at the horizon far away.

The periphery:
- Wide frames add unread guests at the bar as backlit Night[0] silhouettes, the hidden-information rule turned into lighting.
- They add the club's right-hand Deco wall: a fluted pilaster, and an oak back shelf of lit bottles under one cyan neon crescent moon, the night arriving from the east.
- They add one of the game's own palms leaning in from the left.
- The fixed MALIBU CLUB sign floats in the dark sky on the side away from the sun.

Stack, back to front:
- L0 sky
- L1 sun and halo
- L2 skyline and far palms
- L3 bay and glitter
- L4 near palm, wall wing, guests
- L5 Roxy, with the held coupe and card baked in
- L6 counter (in front of her)
- L7 counter props (bottles, shaker, highball)
- L5b pose-A forearms and elbows on the counter top
- L8 effects
- x4 NEAREST
- L9 logo

Genre lessons it encodes:
- Coffee Talk's counter as the stage.
- VA-11 Hall-A's host as the face.
- Red Strings' gesture across the bar, kept to one row.
- Sea of Stars' disc behind the hero.
- Katana ZERO and Hotline Miami's magenta/cyan pair.
- Stardew's calm sky as the logo's field.

The eye line is never claimed to be the game's 30-degree counter view.

**Pixel rules.** 1) GRID. 1 art px = 4x4 upload px in every Steam image. Icons: 1 art px = 8x8.

2) ASSEMBLY, per asset:
- Build the native canvas at ceil(W/4) x ceil(H/4).
- Place every layer at integer native coordinates.
- Enlarge with NEAREST.
- Cut overflow from the RIGHT and BOTTOM only:
  - 920x430: -2 rows
  - 462x174: -2 cols, -2 rows
  - 1232x706: -2 rows
  - 1438x810: -2 cols, -2 rows
  - 800x450: -2 rows
  - 1920x622: -2 rows
  - 748x896, 600x900, 3840x1240, 184x184 and 256x256 are exact
- Composite the logo map 1:1 at x,y multiples of 4.

3) TRANSFORMS. Never scale, rotate or skew a sprite.
- Flips are allowed only for far palms and shelf bottles.
- Guests come in rim-left and rim-right versions; a rimmed sprite is never flipped.
- Never flip Roxy, the sun group or the game's palms: the sun is always on Roxy's screen-left.

4) SPRITES. Binary alpha, keyed from flat #00FF00 on the native grid with despill. 1-px selective outline in the darkest step of the material's own ramp; Night[0] where a silhouette meets the sky; never #000000. No anti-aliasing toward the background; hand AA only inside a shape.

5) LINE WEIGHT. 1 px everywhere. Palms and skyline are filled silhouettes.

6) DITHER: NONE, in any asset. Bands meet on hard stepped edges. Water texture comes from 1-row ripple dashes.

7) EFFECTS ARE LOOKUP TABLES, at most 4 stepped bands.
- Halo: a lift along the sky sequence (L1).
- Neon glow: 2 bands of 1 art px each. Magenta tube: band 1 Magenta[1], band 2 Magenta[0]. Cyan tube: band 1 Cyan[1], band 2 Cyan[0]. A band is applied only where its ink is lighter (L*) than the base.
- Palm light wrap: Magenta[2] over S6-S9. Skylight rim: ClubBlue[2] over S0-S3.
- No Gaussian blur, bloom, flare, grain, scanlines or chromatic aberration.
- No effect may output Graphite, Cream[0]-[2] or identity inks.

8) RIMS, 1 px, never two on one pixel.
- Cyan[4] on every screen-right silhouette edge of Roxy and the props.
- Amber[4] on sun-facing edges within 42 px of the sun centre, except where the background is the disc or S8/S9.
- Magenta[2] on the top edge of Roxy's hair, F-20..F-14.
- Guests: a sun-facing rim, Amber[4] within 42 px of the sun, else ViceRed[4].

9) GLINTS. Cream[4] on Roxy and her held props only at: one catchlight per eye, one pixel on the sun-side hoop, one pixel on the coupe's sugar rim, and the card's top edge. The cherry glint is ViceRed[4]. There is no buckle glint.

10) CLUSTERS, NOT NOISE. No orphan pixels, no doubled lines, contour steps of 1-2-3.
- Stars: at most 1 per 2000 px^2 of S0-S1, plus up to four 3x3 plus-stars, none within 60 px of the sun and none in a pad.
- Windows: 2x1 Amber[3] runs, at most 1 per 40 px^2.
- Birds: 5x2 (.X.X. over X...X).

11) ROXY'S HEAD IS NEVER REGENERATED OR RESNAPPED. Copy idle_00 rows 4-43, cols 86-131 1:1, with sprite (108, 23) = F. Allowed edits: catchlights, rims, and the halter V.

12) AI TAKES (wall wing, guests, optional tower or prop references).
- Preferred: PixelLab at native size, which needs no snapping.
- Gemini takes go through the FIXED pixelsnap.py: a forced float period (take height / target native height) with phase search only; the median of the centre 50% of each cell; the explicit 84-ink palette in OKLab; the #00FF00 key; despeckle; binary alpha.
- If the period drifts more than 5% across the take, use it only as a reference and redraw.

13) DELIVERY. PNG-8 indexed when the image has <= 256 colours, otherwise PNG-24. sRGB, no gamma or ICC chunks, no metadata. The community icon is JPG q95 4:4:4. Steam re-encodes store images to JPG, so gate 5 tests the JPG.

- Shadows: ClubBlue/Night, never black or grey.

SHARE TARGETS per frame:
- Night/ClubBlue about 55-65%
- Magenta/ViceRed/Amber about 25-30%
- Cyan <= 10% (logo subtitle and coupe, moon sign, rims, highball, cyan liquids)
- no single ink > 50% (Night[1] alone is about 45% of the portrait capsules)
- pixels with S > 0.4 <= 40%

### Layers

#### L0 Sky plate
Redrawn per canvas from the hero group, never cropped or resampled. Bands as in the palette table (rows above H, cool tops fixed at 54/38/26).

WARM STACK.
- At a column with horizontal distance dx from the sun, the warm stack has W = round(22 x t) rows, with t = max(0.6, exp(-(dx/200)^2)).
- The stack is filled from the TOP DOWN: S4 5 rows, S5 4, S6 4, S7 4, S8 3, S9 2. It is cut at W, so the hottest bands vanish first and the far horizon ends in Magenta[3]/[2].
- S3 grows down to meet it.
- So gold and coral live only near the sun and the warm stack recedes to a pink line: no straight-sided chevrons, no mirrored diamond.
- HERO, left of the sun only: t = exp(-(dx/120)^2) with no floor. Nothing warm remains left of native x of about 280 (upload 1120).
- Boundaries change by at most 1 row per step, with runs of at least 2 px.

LOGO SIDE. Beyond each pad's sun-side edge, every boundary is horizontal (it holds its row). Edges never cross a subtitle; the per-asset beds list which rows fall where.

CLOUDS. 2 altostratus streaks, 1-2 rows tall and 20-50 px long, within 130 px of the sun and outside pads and the hero field. Bodies Night[4]/Magenta[1], sun-side undersides ViceRed[3]. None crosses the disc.

STARS. Single Cream[3] px in S0-S1, at most 1 per 2000 px^2, plus up to four 3x3 plus-stars (Cream[3] arms, Cream[4] centre). None in pads and none within 60 px of the sun.

BIRDS. 3-5 birds, 5x2 px, Night[1], only in S4-S6 and outside pads.

*Native size:* Procedural per canvas; reference 960x310

*Generation brief:* CODE, not generated. Rewrite Tools/steam_page/plate.py profile() to the fixed cool tops plus the truncated warm stack; delete its striped synthwave sun and all dither.

Optional Gemini mood reference (never shipped): 'Pixel-art 21:9 sunset over a calm bay, Miami 1985, crisp square pixels, no anti-aliasing, no dithering. Flat horizontal colour bands with hard stepped edges: deep night purple #1A1023 at the top, #241830, navy #1F2E66, violet #4A3160, then a warm stack of magenta #8F2464 #C23283 #E84DA6, coral #F27D8A and gold #E8A33D #F5C97B that is deepest around a low sun and shrinks to a thin pink line toward both edges. A few M-shaped birds, sparse single-pixel stars at the top. No perspective grid, no stripes on the sun, no text, no letters, no logo.'

#### L1 Sun and halo
Centre S = F + (-30, +24), radius 12. The bottom of the disc sits 6 rows above H.

DISC.
- Upper two-thirds: #FCED5F core with a 1-px Amber[4] rim.
- Lower third: Amber[4] with an Amber[3] rim.
- Its bottom 2 rows sit behind the towers ('on the towers'). The coupe bowl is silhouetted on its upper half; her hair and the sun-side arm cover part of its right side.
- At least 45% stays visible, with the upper-left arc unbroken. There is no hair lock in front of it, and the sun-side upper arm stays right of F.x-22 down to the elbow at F+(-22,+40).

HALO. A lift along the sky sequence, sky only (behind skyline, palms and Roxy):

| Ring | Radius | Lift |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | <= 15 | +3 |
| 2 | <= 21 | +2 |
| 3 | <= 27 | +1 |
| 4 | <= 33 | +1, on S0-S3 only (a violet corona in the night) |

- Rows already S7-S9 are never lifted; nothing lifts past S9, so no ring is brighter than the disc's own rim.
- Within 2 px of Roxy's silhouette the lift is 0. That dark contour keeps her hair and skin off the hot ring.
- Every pad stays at least 33 px from S, so no ring enters a pad.

Glitter starts at H directly under the disc (L3).

*Native size:* Disc 25x25; halo 67x67

*Generation brief:* CODE. Never generated. Never a striped sun, never a palm across the disc, never a second sun.

- No letters.

The two-value read is a cyan cup over a bright disc cut by a dark stem, and it must hold at 16 px.

*Native size:* 23x23 at x8 (184); 32x32 at x8 (256); ICO frames 16, 24, 32 and 48 hand-drawn 1:1

*Generation brief:* HAND-PIXELLED; never generated, never shrunk. Draw the 32 first, then 16, 24 and 48; the 256 is the 32 at x8 and the 184 is the 23 at x8.

Optional reference only: 'Pixel-art app icon: a cocktail coupe whose cyan-outlined bowl (#7DF0E3 outline, #3BC8BE liquid) floats on a deep night-purple field #1A1023 above a large low golden sun (#FCED5F, #F5C97B, #E8A33D rim), its dark stem and foot crossing the sun, the sun half-sunk behind a dark bay (#362447, #241830), magenta and violet rings, crisp square pixels, no text.'

### Community icon (184x184)

- **pixel scale:** x8 exact: native 23x23 -> 184x184. Exempt from x4: shown at 16-32 px.

- **logo:** No wordmark: the coupe-on-sun logomark (L10).

- **character:** None.

- **background:** Native 23x23 grid at x8:
  - Field: Night[1], full bleed.
  - Sun: centre (11, 13), radius 7. #FCED5F to r 4, Amber[4] to r 6, Amber[3] rim. Halo r 8-9 Magenta[1], r 10 Night[4]. Horizon at row 18, so the disc shows rows 6-17.
  - Bay: rows 18-19 Night[3], rows 20-22 Night[2]. Amber[4] glint dashes at row 19 (x 9-13) and row 21 (x 10-12).
  - Coupe: rim at row 2 (x 4-18), Cyan[4] with one Cream[4] px. Bowl rows 3-7 tapering to x 9-13: Cyan[4] outline, Cyan[3] then Cyan[2] liquid, and a Night[0] keyline where it touches the disc. Stem at x 11, rows 8-16, Night[0] across the gold. Foot at rows 17-18, x 8-14, Night[0].

- **focal and eye line:** The glass against the sun.

- **safe zones:** The mark stays inside the centre 21x21. It must read at 32 and 16 px (library list, chat, notifications): a cyan cup over a bright disc cut by a dark stem.

- **format:** JPG as Steamworks asks: quality 95, chroma 4:4:4 (no subsampling), exported from the PNG master.

- **notes:** Hand-pixelled, never generated. The same mark as the client icon, so the library list, chat and shortcut show one symbol.

### Client / shortcut icon (256x256 (plus a multi-resolution .ico))

- **pixel scale:** x8: native 32x32 -> 256x256. The small ICO frames are 1:1 hand pixels.

- **logo:** The same coupe-on-sun mark. No letters.

- **character:** None.

- **background:** Native 32x32 at x8, a redraw rather than a scale-up of the 23:
  - Sun: centre (16, 19), radius 10. Core to r 6, Amber[4] to r 9, Amber[3] rim. Halo r 12-13 Magenta[1], r 14-15 Night[4]. Horizon at row 26.
  - Coupe: rim at row 3 (x 6-26); bowl rows 3-10 above the disc; stem x 15-16, rows 11-24; foot rows 25-27, x 10-21.
  - Bay rows 26-31 with 2 glint dashes.
  - A Night[1] tile with 2-px stepped corners (binary alpha).
  
  ICO frames, hand-drawn 1:1:
  - 16: sun r 5 at (8, 10), horizon at row 13, bowl rows 1-5 (x 3-12), stem x 7-8 (rows 6-12), foot row 13 (x 5-10).
  - 24: redrawn the same way.
  - 32: the native.
  - 48: redrawn the same way.

- **focal and eye line:** The glass against the sun.

- **safe zones:** Must read at the 16, 24, 32 and 48 px that the taskbar and Explorer use.

- **format:** A multi-resolution .ico (hand-drawn 16/24/32/48 plus the 256 PNG-compressed). Valve generates its own .ico from a PNG, which would throw the hand frames away. Also a 256x256 PNG (RGBA, binary alpha) if the field asks for PNG.

- **notes:** Draw the 32 frame first, then the 16. Derive nothing by shrinking.
